dsDescriptionValue.value: Interview with Jørgen Wadum regarding the history of the development of technical art history, the space occupied by technical art history in the educational realm, and the personal practice of Jørgen Wadum. For the purpose of gaining a deeper understanding of the ways in which the field is perceived and applied by those who practice it.
